autoQueue.title: Auto-Queue
autoQueue.newFilesHelp: New files detected in scanned folders by the watcher that need conversion or audio cleanup will be automatically added to the queue using your default encoding settings.
autoQueue.priorityHelp: Newly-detected files use this priority. Rules with a Queue Priority action override this setting.

filters.title: Conversion Filters
filters.help: Set to 0 to disable. Typical bitrates: DVD ~4-5 Mbps, 720p WEB ~3-5 Mbps, 1080p WEB ~5-10 Mbps, 1080p Blu-ray ~20-40 Mbps, 4K SDR ~40-60 Mbps, 4K HDR Remux ~60-100+ Mbps. Set min bitrate to 3 to skip already-compressed files. Set max bitrate to 80 to preserve 4K HDR remuxes.

filename.title: Output Filename
filename.help: Appended to the filename before the extension after conversion. Example: Movie x265{{suffix}}.mkv. Leave empty for no suffix.

originals.title: Originals & Backups
originals.trash: Move originals to trash after conversion
originals.trashHelp: After a successful conversion, the original file is moved to the system trash instead of being permanently deleted.
originals.help: Leave empty to use .shrinkerr_backup in the same directory. Set an absolute path (e.g. /media/backups) for centralized storage. Backup files are required for the Undo Conversion feature — without backups, conversions cannot be reverted.
originals.deleteAllConfirm_one: Delete {{count}} backup file ({{size}} GB)? This cannot be undone.
originals.deleteAllConfirm_other: Delete all {{count}} backup files ({{size}} GB)? This cannot be undone.

stability.title: File Stability
stability.delayHelp: Files modified within this window are postponed during scanning and auto-queue. They'll be picked up on the next scan once the window has passed. This prevents converting files that are still being downloaded, transferred, or processed by other tools like Sonarr/Radarr. Recommended for shared systems.

health.title: Health Checks
health.afterScanHelp: After each scan, queue a health check for files newly detected in the last 24h (capped at 1000 per scan to protect the queue). Quick parses headers (under 1s per file). Thorough decodes every frame (slow — minutes per file). To check files retroactively, use the manual Quick check / Thorough check buttons on the Scanner.
health.clearPendingConfirm: Delete ALL pending health-check jobs? Running jobs and other job types are not affected.
health.afterConversionHelp: Verify each converted output. Quick confirms the container/streams parse. Thorough catches visual artifacts (decoder errors) at the cost of roughly duration/10 per file.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.help: Custom flags are inserted before the output path in the ffmpeg command. Max Plex API calls limits concurrent requests to your Plex server (0 = unlimited).

webhooks.title: Webhook Endpoints
webhooks.intro: External tools can call these endpoints to control Shrinkerr. Authenticate with ?api_key=YOUR_KEY or X-Api-Key header.

script.title: Post-Conversion Script
script.intro: Run a custom script after each conversion completes. The script receives job details as environment variables.
script.pathHelp: Absolute path to an executable script inside the container. Leave empty to disable.

auth.title: Authentication
auth.loginRequired: Login required. Visitors will need either the username + password below or the API key (workers / scripts). If you lock yourself out, see the recovery instructions in the README.
auth.passwordHelp: Leave empty to keep current password
auth.regenerate: Regenerate API key (server-side; takes effect immediately)
auth.apiKeyHelp: Used by NZBGet, SABnzbd, remote workers, and other external integrations. Not required for browser login. Shown masked — click 👁 to reveal or ⧉ to copy the full key.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.languageHelp: Notifications (Discord, Telegram, email, webhooks…) are sent in this language, independent of the interface language chosen in each browser.
notifications.intro: Get notified when the queue completes, a job fails, or disk space is low.

backups.title: Backups
backups.intro: Backups include the full database (scan results, jobs, settings, rules) as a zip file.
backups.restoreConfirm: Restore from {{name}}? This will replace your current database. A safety backup will be created first.
backups.restoreUploadConfirm: Restore from uploaded file {{name}}? This will replace your current database.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
shortcuts.note: Shortcuts are disabled when typing in input fields.

updates.title: Updates
updates.checkFailed: Couldn't check upstream — offline or rate-limited.

support.title: Support
support.intro: Documentation, source, and where to report issues.

docs.title: Documentation
docs.desc: Installation, encoding guide, remote workers, rules, best practices, troubleshooting.

repo.title: GitHub repository
repo.desc: Source code, releases, discussions, and container images.

issue.title: Report an issue
issue.desc: Include your version, image variant, and a relevant log excerpt (see docs → Troubleshooting).

support.tmdb: This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.

toasts.apiKeyRegenerated: API key regenerated — copy and update your worker / NZBGet / SABnzbd configs
toasts.backupRestored: Backup restored. Restart the container for full effect.
toasts.updateCheckFailed: Couldn't reach GitHub — try again in a moment
